description: Proposed Rear extension, part single Single storey side extension; single and two storey rear extension;; alterations and extension to roof including rear dormer; external alterations (demolition of storage)
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: </p><p>L000_ Existing Location Plan_OS MAP, L100_ Proposed Location Plan_OS MAP, L001_ Existing Site Plan, L101_ Proposed Site Plan, P001_Existing Ground and First Floor,&nbsp; P101_Proposed Ground and First Floor, P002_Existing Level 02 and Roof Plan, P102_Proposed Level 02 and Roof Plan, S001_Existing Sections, S101_Proposed Sections, E001_Existing Front and Rear Elevation, E101_Proposed Front and Rear Elevation, E002_Existing Side Elevations, E102_Proposed Side Elevations, V001_Existing 3D Views., V101_Proposed 3D Views. and Design and Access statement.&nbsp;</p><p></p>

The first floor windows in the side elevation overlooking no. 9&nbsp; of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
